title: Trump welcomes China's Xi for high-stakes summit
summary: Donald Trump welcomed Xi Jinping to the US by greeting him personally at the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews. The two are expected to discuss trade, AI, Taiwan and Iran.

image.caption: Donald and Melania Trump greet Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at Joint Base Andrews, MarylandImage: Kevin Lamarque/REUTERS

items: Donald Trump welcomed his Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping, to Washington for a multi-day state visit
This is Xi's first state visit to the US in a decade
Trade, AI, Taiwan, Ukraine and Iran are key issues to be discussed

The main summit between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping is scheduled for Thursday.
There's a state dinner as well in the evening, with both leaders expected to deliver speeches.
Top US tech executives are expected to attend the dinner, suggesting that artificial intelligence will likely be a big topic of discussion.
